label: Match Restore Lab
description: Extra test and debug commands for match_restore: item respawn timers, item entity tools, setting the match clock by hand and restoring a single player. Not needed for a real restore. Needs match_restore enabled.

commands.name: spawnsec
commands.description: Hides an item and shows it again after the given seconds; list, scan and reset manage this map's overrides.

commands.name: itemlab
commands.description: Item entity tools: pick an item up now or after a delay, respawn it after a delay, or show its state.

commands.name: matchtime
commands.description: Shows or sets the current match clock.

commands.name: restoreplayer
commands.description: Restores a single player's state from an exported snapshot.

cvars.label: Enabled
cvars.description: Shared with match_restore: turning it off disables match_restore as well as these commands.
